Lemma
[Minkowski's inequality] ↗ lem:holders-inequality 1. appB:B.2-f\group Elementary Inequalities

If $1\leq p\leq \infty $ and $u,v\in L^p(U)$, then \[ (9)\qquad \| u+v\| _{L^p(U)} \leq \| u\| _{L^p(U)}+\| v\| _{L^p(U)}. \]
Proof

\sketch For $1\leq p<\infty $, write

\[ \int _U|u+v|^p\, dx \leq \int _U|u+v|^{p-1}(|u|+|v|)\, dx \]

and apply Hölder separately to the two terms. This bounds the right side by

\[ \| u+v\| _{L^p}^{p-1} (\| u\| _{L^p}+\| v\| _{L^p}); \]

division yields (9), with the zero-norm case immediate. For $p=\infty $, use the pointwise triangle inequality and take the essential supremum.

□
